name: The Creative Living Room Summer Camp
operator_name: The Creative Living Room (Park Avenue Community Center)
description_short: Week-long themed arts camps run at two sites, Park Avenue Community Center in Swarthmore and Congregation Beth Israel in Media. Each week has its own theme, from theater, filmmaking and crafts to chess, nature and Harry Potter, led by professional teaching artists, with half-day and full-day options for ages 5 to 12 and some teen weeks for ages 11 to 15.
refund_policy_summary: The $100 deposit per camp spot is non-refundable. Written cancellations before May 1 owe no balance; after May 1, cancelling 4 or more weeks ahead gets full credit, 2 to 4 weeks ahead a 50% credit, and under 2 weeks nothing. Credits go to Park Avenue Community Center programs; a full refund if the camp cancels for low enrollment.
notes: 2026 fees: half day 9:00 to 1:00 $230, full day 9:00 to 4:00 $395; 15% sibling discount. After care 4:00 to 5:00 at the Media site only, $10 per day. Second site: Congregation Beth Israel of Media, 542 S. New Middletown Road, Media. Themes differ by site. The Creative Living Room merged with Park Avenue Community Center in September 2025. No week by week dates are posted on the camp pages.
